# Liu's Natural Way Health Center

> Oakland Chinatown acupuncture and Chinese herbal medicine clinic led by Dr. Rui Qiong Liu, Doctor of Oriental Medicine (South Baylo University), 35+ years clinical experience, 20 years serving Oakland. Specializing in pain management support for auto, work, and sports injuries. Worker's Compensation and Personal Injury accepted. Located at 324 10th St #131, Oakland, CA 94607. Phone (510) 599-9804. Hours Mon-Fri 10AM-6PM, Sat-Sun 1PM-6PM.

## About
- [About Dr. Liu](https://liusnaturalway.us/about/): Licensed acupuncturist, education, license verification, clinic photos
- [Contact and Hours](https://liusnaturalway.us/contact/): Address, phone, map, parking

## Services
- [Acupuncture](https://liusnaturalway.us/docs/acupuncture/): Acupuncture using single-use disposable needles for wellness and pain management support
- [Acupressure Tuina Massage](https://liusnaturalway.us/docs/acupressure-tuina/): Licensed massage with cupping, gua-sha, hot stone options
- [Cupping Therapy](https://liusnaturalway.us/docs/cupping-therapy/): Cupping and gua-sha as adjunct therapies

## Pricing
- New patient consultation with acupuncture: $150
- Follow-up acupuncture: $100 per session
- Massage: $45 per 30 min, $80 per 60 min, $110 per 90 min, $150 per 120 min
- Cupping or Gua-sha: $45 per 30 min add-on
- Worker's Comp and Auto Accident: No out-of-pocket, we bill insurance directly

## Why Choose Us
- 20 years in Oakland Chinatown, serving Bay Area
- Licensed and insured, disposable needles only
- Work injury and auto accident documentation support
- Herbal consultation available
